paragraphs.text: Field under test: max_read_date (returned in the API as maxReadDate)
Work Item: #643243 — Custom Forecast support (previously out of scope in the main Forecast API max_read_date PBI)

As a consumer of Forecast APIs, I want the Forecast API to return the correct max_read_date for PODs whose selected/best forecast is a Custom Forecast, so that I can validate the freshness of the underlying data even when no meter-read table (Scalar/IDR/Day Match) applies.
AC1 — Use Custom Forecast Upload Date as Max Read Date

Given a POD has a Custom Forecast selected, and the Custom Forecast does not have an associated HU, when the forecast response is triggered, then the Custom Forecast upload date/time shall be used as the Max Read Date.

QA interpretation: For PODs where the selected forecast is Custom AND no HU (historical usage) is associated with it, maxReadDate is not sourced from pod_scalar_meterread_clean or the interval table at all — it comes from the Custom Forecast's own upload date/time.
AC2 — Send Upload Timestamp in Response

Given a Custom Forecast is identified as the Best Forecast for a POD, when the outbound payload is created, then the uploaded timestamp of the Custom Forecast shall be populated in the Max Read Date field.
QA interpretation: Contract-level check — when a Custom Forecast is is_best for a POD, the response's maxReadDate field must carry the upload timestamp.
Source: therm-integration.md, “API Endpoints → 2. POST /pod-forecast-batch-results” and “X-Host: pod-forecast-result → Forecast Data”.
maxReadDate — for Custom Forecast PODs, this field is sourced per AC1/AC2 above (Custom Forecast upload date/time) instead of pod_scalar_meterread_clean / pod_intervalclean.

Max read dates are fetched from pod_scalar_meterread_clean and pod_intervalclean — for Custom Forecast PODs (per AC1), this step must instead resolve to the Custom Forecast's own upload date/time when no HU is associated
